evals.prompt: Users should be able to export their data. Interview me until you can write the spec.
evals.expected_output: Reads the relevant code, asks a few targeted questions at a time, then writes a spec from the template with checkable 'done when' items and asks for approval before any implementation.

evals.prompt: Fix the typo in the README heading.
evals.expected_output: Surveys the scope, announces 'Setup (first call): solo' with the reason (one file, no unknowns, no risky areas), writes 2-5 'done when' lines, edits it directly, and starts no other role.

evals.prompt: The reviewer says the export ignores the date filter, but the spec never mentions a date filter.
evals.expected_output: Treats it as a spec gap: asks the user whether the filter is required, updates the spec if so, and only then sends the gap back to the implementer.

evals.prompt: Write the spec for the export feature. Our AGENTS.md says specs go in docs/design/ as YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>.md using docs/design/TEMPLATE.md.
evals.expected_output: Writes the spec to docs/design/<date>-export.md in the project's template, not docs/specs/, and adds a 'done when' section only if that template has no place for it.

evals.prompt: Round each line's refund down to whole units instead of rounding the total. It only touches the refund function.
evals.expected_output: Treats it as a risky area (money) despite one file: announces 'Setup (first call): spec needed', writes a spec with edge scenarios, then 'Setup (final): with review', implements in this session, and runs the reviewer role before reporting.

evals.prompt: (Solo change in progress) The fix for the date label now also touches the payment and invoice modules: four files changed.
evals.expected_output: At the re-check (step 9) raises the setup to with review, tells the user, writes a short spec from what was decided, and runs the reviewer role on the diff since the starting commit before reporting.

evals.prompt: The approved spec lists eight files across the payment, notification and reporting modules; payment and notification do not share files.
evals.expected_output: Announces 'Setup (final): split' with the reason, hands the two independent groups to separate implementers by requirement numbers, and does not edit code itself.

evals.prompt: (During the interview, after asking about the date filter) By the way, the export must never include deleted users; legal asked for that last year.
evals.expected_output: Records the remark, with its reason, as a behavior statement under 'Added requirements' in the spec and turns it into a requirement or constraint with a scenario, rather than leaving it in the conversation; the conversation check before approval counts it as placed.

evals.prompt: Add a discount field to the checkout API. (AGENTS.md has a 'Project → Change pipeline' section listing 'API request/response examples' as an extra spec section and 'src/billing/' as a risky area.)
evals.expected_output: Reports the project settings in the scope note, treats src/billing/ as a risky area (spec needed), and includes an API request/response examples section in the spec.
